description: Marks whether a client's Google review is in, as the client card's Mark posted / Undo posted does: posted true stops every review ask and resolves the open review-chase steps; posted false takes the mark back. do_not_ask also stops the asks without a review (the same effect as the outcome route's declined), and markAskedNow stamps today as the first ask. The change is attributed to the person and idempotent: a re-save with no change writes nothing. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: mark_review_posted
title: Mark a client's Google review as posted
